Class OwnerService

java.lang.Object
service.OwnerService
All Implemented Interfaces:
Service
public class OwnerService extends Object implements Service
Service layer responsible for handling business logic related to Owner entities.

This class acts as an intermediary between the DAO layer (OwnerDao) and higher-level components, providing operations such as creation, retrieval, update, deletion, filtering, and JSON serialization.

Author:
Michal Salabura
